tasks.name: Fleet Coordinated Takeoff and Formation (5 Drones) 1
tasks.content: Five-drone coordination exercise: Drone 1, Drone 2, Drone 5, Drone 4, and Drone 7 take off together to 26 meters altitude, then hold formation at positions (488, 446, 26), (552, 452, 26), (837, 493, 26), (575, 616, 26), and (407, 580, 26) respectively for synchronized operation. Then all five drones move north for 100m, and next move east for 83m. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (north 100m, then east 83m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.

All drones must complete the full directional distance (north 100m, east 83m) from their respective positions, adjusting as needed to avoid obstacles.

Five-drone formation drill: launch Drone 1, Drone 2, Drone 5, Drone 4, and Drone 7 to altitude 26m, hold stations at (488, 446, 26), (552, 452, 26), (837, 493, 26), (575, 616, 26), and (407, 580, 26) respectively, then shift north by 100 meters and east by 83 meters in synchronized operation. Each drone travels the specified distance in each direction regardless of obstacles encountered.

Execute synchronized operation with Drone 1, Drone 2, Drone 5, Drone 4, Drone 7: take off reaching 26 meters height, maintain formation at coordinates (488, 446, 26), (552, 452, 26), (837, 493, 26), (575, 616, 26), and (407, 580, 26) respectively, then proceed north for 100m and subsequently east for 83m together, with each drone completing the full directed movements by repositioning around obstacles if necessary.

Five-drone coordinated maneuver: Drone 1, Drone 2, Drone 5, Drone 4, and Drone 7 lift off to 26m elevation, hold formation positions at (488, 446, 26), (552, 452, 26), (837, 493, 26), (575, 616, 26), and (407, 580, 26) respectively, then travel north 100 meters and east 83 meters in sequence. The specified directional distances must be achieved by each drone, adapting position to circumvent any obstacles.
